memos.scout:
The strongest case for buying SUKI is the last 15 minutes: 696 buyers and 603 SOL of buy volume against 589 SOL of sells, with net flow of +13.86 SOL and a +1.8% return. That is genuine two-sided trading rather than a single wallet cycling, and the class is tagged ORGANIC with no airdrop dump seen. The 30-minute return of +6.5% is modest but positive, and the 18% drawdown from the high is the kind of pullback that buyers have been absorbing. Pool depth of 234 SOL is reasonable for a $20 ticket.

The case has real holes, though. The launch was bundled (bundle_share 1.0, top-3 share 1.0, only 2 buyers on the curve), a launch bot was present, and the first two minutes saw a 0.42 sell-to-buy ratio with the top 5 buyers holding 59%. Net flow over 15 minutes is only +2.3% of volume, so buying and selling nearly cancel. Demand looks present now but thin relative to churn, and the case for it lasting 30-60 minutes is weak. I would not buy on this brief.
memos.skeptic: The most likely way this loses money is insider distribution through the curve's concentrated early holders. The curve data shows bundle_share 1.0 and top3_share 1.0, with only 2 curve buyers, meaning the early supply sits with a tiny cluster, not a crowd. The first 2 minutes after graduation show a launch bot present, top5_buyer_share 0.5948, and sell_to_buy_ratio 0.4153, so insiders have already been selling into the buy flow. Last 15 minutes: sell_sol 589 against buy_sol 603 leaves net_flow of only 13.86 SOL, so the recent "volume" is mostly churn that has not sustained price. Drawdown of 18.4% from the 30-minute high shows the bounce is already fading. With a 1.4-5.1% round-trip cost and a pool of 234.67 SOL, a modest dip can be wiped out by fees or a single large seller. Skip.
